preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= r2 <= n and r1 != r2
preconditions.description: The indices of the old and new capitals r1 and r2 must be valid city indices and different from each other.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n-1 integers, each representing a valid city index.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 integers representing the new road map.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be a valid city index.
The new capital r2 must point to itself in the output.
